title: Petrus a S. Joseph — glory-election before foresight of merits
source_text: XVII. Bellarmino hac in parte astipulatur Petrus a Sancto Joseph cujus haec est Resolutio. Probabilior est sententia quae docet, electionem efficacem ad gloriam factam esse antecedenter ad absolutam praevisionem meritorum, adeoque esse mere gratuitam. In Idea Theologiae speculativae lib. 1. cap. 20. Resolutione 1.
pass_a_gloss: Petrus a Sancto Joseph agrees with Bellarmine on this part, whose Resolution is this. More probable is the opinion which teaches that efficacious election to glory was made antecedently to the absolute foresight of merits, and therefore is merely gratuitous. In the Idea of Speculative Theology book 1 chapter 20 Resolution 1.
pass_b_english: Petrus a S. Joseph sides with Bellarmine.
Efficacious glory-election before absolute foresight of merits.
Therefore merely gratuitous — Idea Theol. I.20 Res. 1.
